quarterly_data.signal: Supply contract disclosed 10-19-2026: '2027 North America data center power-equipment supply PJT' - LS Electric supplies switchgear to its subsidiary LS ELECTRIC AMERICA Inc., which won a US hyperscale data-center power-equipment supply project (end customer not disclosed). The company had already won the 2026 delivery portion of this project (USD 114,974,772; related disclosure 04-13-2026); this contract is the follow-on 2027 delivery portion. Contract value KRW 168,871,711,050 = USD 125,229,300 at the Hana Bank rate of KRW 1,348.50 on the contract date, 3.40% of recent revenue (KRW 4,965,798,552,980, FY2025 consolidated); purchase order issued 2026-10-16; term 2026-10-16 to 2027-12-31; supply region United States; advance payment: none; billed per product delivery schedule. Term and amount may change.
